discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis using reversible-terminator chemistry)
rationale: The Chemistry prize tends to alternate between materials and the life-science side. The 2025 prize went to metal-organic frameworks, a materials topic, so a biochemistry-flavoured prize looks likely for 2026. Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis rests on fundamental chemistry: fluorescent reversible terminators and surface cluster amplification. It has transformed biology and medicine. The work has already received major prizes, including the Breakthrough Prize and the Millennium Technology Prize, which often come before a Nobel.
